narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>In three minus x, times x minus six, minus x times minus six is minus six x.
<bookmark mark='sign'/>Two minus signs multiplied together give plus.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>That slip spoils the sign of one term, so the whole answer changes.

<bookmark mark='c2'/>In the first one, take u as one and v as four. The brackets give four times one, which is four.
<bookmark mark='c3'/>The expanded form gives twelve, minus three, plus four, minus nine, which is also four.

old_misconception.wrong_answer: minus x times minus six is minus six x
old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu takes −x × −6 as −6x in (3 − x)(x − 6). Two negatives multiply to a positive, so the term is +6x.
